executive_summary: Maven build failed with a single compilation error in ColumnServiceImpl. The ColumnDataStore interface is missing the countByColumnId(String) method that ColumnServiceImpl attempts to call. This is a straightforward interface contract violation that requires adding the missing method signature to the ColumnDataStore interface.

errors.root_cause: ColumnServiceImpl at line 25 calls columnDataStore.countByColumnId(columnId) but ColumnDataStore interface does not declare this method.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add method signature 'long countByColumnId(String columnId);' to the ColumnDataStore interface.
